leaves.doc: elkies-coord: Elkies, Shimura curve computations (ANTS-III 1998) section 3 on X*(6) = X6/W in his function-field form on the canonical witness: Q(X6)^W = Q(t) whenever X6 is integral and t regular at its generic point (both proved from the charts) (t generates the function field of X6/W; W = {1,w2,w3,w6} by its moduli action, acting by pullback on Mathlib's function field), t = 0, 1, infinity at the CM points of discriminant -24, -4, -3, and the charts s^2 = -t, r^2 = 3(t-1) (section, display and 0/infinity orientation UNVERIFIED). Replaces elkiesX6StarPrinted (its Qbar-point fibre clause is proved: elkiesX6StarPrinted_of_functionField).
leaves.source: Elkies 1998 (ANTS-III, LNCS 1423) section 3, X*(6) = X6/W with coordinate t (function-field form Q(X6)^W = Q(t)), CM values and equations of X6 over the t-line (section, display and 0/infinity orientation UNVERIFIED)
